risks.title: Revenue concentration on OCS disposable sets
risks.score_rationale: The company's revenue model heavily depends on ongoing sales of OCS disposable sets and consoles. The business model requires recurring consumable purchases from transplant centers, creating dependency on product adoption and reimbursement sustainability.

risks.title: Critical accounting estimates and judgments
risks.score_rationale: Financial statement preparation requires significant estimates and management judgments affecting reported amounts, including inventory valuation, revenue recognition timing, and deferred tax assets.

risks.title: Variable interest rate exposure on CIBC credit facility
risks.score_rationale: Outstanding $60.0 million CIBC borrowing carries variable interest rate (5.7% as of December 31, 2025) with monthly principal repayments starting July 2026. Rising rates directly increase debt service costs.

risks.title: Material lease obligations for new global headquarters
risks.score_rationale: New Somerville, Massachusetts lease beginning Q1 2028 commits company to $23.9 million annual base rent with 2% increases for first three years, then 3% thereafter over 16-year term. Represents significant future cash obligation.

risks.title: Foreign exchange exposure on international operations
risks.score_rationale: Company operates internationally including R&D and manufacturing expansion in Italy without documented hedging strategy for foreign currency transactions.

risks.title: Inventory obsolescence and valuation risk
risks.score_rationale: Company maintains inventory reserves for excess and obsolete stock. Manufacturing and supply chain expansion increases inventory levels, amplifying obsolescence risk if product demand changes.

ai_positioning.summary: TransMedics makes no mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company's strategic focus centers on warm perfusion technology, regulatory approvals for multi-organ OCS platforms, and commercial expansion of its transplant logistics services (NOP).
